summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=node setup.mjs, which fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, downloads the Bun runtime, unpacks the platform-specific binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line JavaScript file using string-array rotation obfuscation (push/shift shuffler over a numeric-literal lookup array) with no statically readable behavior. The package presents as a Vue example project with an empty description and only vue/vue-class-component as declared dependencies — nothing in the advertised purpose requires an alternate JavaScript runtime. Fetching an alien runtime at preinstall specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated sibling file is an alternate-runtime dropper: the payload runs with full user privileges on the installer's host and evades Node-based scanners that will not introspect Bun-executed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
